name: Manastorm: a group member who leaves the run loses the gadget buffs (#11363)
contract: Player report (#11363): Manastorm gadget buffs stayed on players after they left the run. The solo case is
manastorm-leave-clears-gadget-buffs-11363. A group member leaves through LeaveRunMember instead, which now
keeps the gadget auras until the return teleport succeeds, so a failed teleport rolls the member back with the
buffs intact. This Duo case covers the successful path: n2 casts Long Haul Liquid (293453) inside the run,
leaves through the native leave request (1637) and must lose the aura while keeping an ordinary buff (Arcane
Intellect 1459). n1 stays in the run, so the run itself does not end.

steps.label: n2 slots Long Haul Liquid in loadout slot 0
SETUP: n2's loadout request is accepted
Give n2 an ordinary saved buff as the control
n2 joins n1's group so the run starts in Duo mode
n1 entered the private Manastorm instance
n2 entered the private Manastorm instance
n2 casts Long Haul Liquid inside the run
SETUP: n2 has the Long Haul Liquid aura
n2 leaves the run through the native leave request
Leaving the group run removes n2's Long Haul Liquid aura
CONTROL: n2 keeps the ordinary buff
CONTROL: n1 is still in the run, so n2 left as a member and the run did not end
